parameters.help_en: The type of the configuration item. Set the value to web_path
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of the web directory. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and contains the following fields:

webPathType: the type of the web directory
webPath: the web directory
parameters.help_zh:
Web路径配置信息。JSON格式，包含以下字段：

webPathType：Web路径类型
webPath：Web路径
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en:
The protected asset to which the web directory belongs. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and contains the following fields:

target: the protected asset.
targetType: the type of the asset. Set the value to uuid.
flag: the type of the operation
parameters.help_zh:
web目录防护的资产。JSON格式，包含以下字段：

target：防护资产
targetType：资产类型，固定取值为uuid
flag：操作类型
parameters.name: target

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
